MODULE.TITLE: Recover Password
MODULE.HINT: Enter your account details and choose a new password.

MESSAGE.SUCCESS: Your password has been reset. You can now sign in.
MESSAGE.ERROR: Unable to reset your password. The recovery link may be invalid or expired.

FIELD_PLACEHOLDER.USERNAME: Enter your username, email, or mobile

HINT.PASS_RECOVER_TOKEN: Use recovery token from your email, or click the link.

VALIDATION.USERNAME: Username, email, or mobile is required.
VALIDATION.USERNAME_MIN_LENGTH: Username, email, or mobile must be at least {{min_length}} characters long.
VALIDATION.IDENTIFY_MIN_LENGTH: Password must be at least {{min_length}} characters long.
VALIDATION.IDENTIFY_PATTERN: Use uppercase, lowercase, a number and a special character; avoid 3 identical characters in a row.
VALIDATION.PASS_RECOVER_TOKEN: A valid recovery token is required.
